caption: 💌 FOLLOW along for more calm toddler snack ideas 💡 you won’t want to miss what’s coming next!  🍠💛 EPISODE #1 of the Calm Sweet Potato Series 🍠💛 ⚡⭐ Soft Energy Balls for Toddlers Ultra-tender, naturally sweet, and packed with slow energy, healthy fats, and fiber 👌 perfect for little hands and calm snack moments. Ingredients: • 50 g (1/3 cup) Sweet potato puree • 80 g (1/3 cup) Prunes (soaked & pitted) • 50 g (½ cup) Chopped almonds • ½ tbsp Cocoa powder or carob • Coating: ground seeds (sunflower, pumpkin, sesame) Instructions: 1. Mix all ingredients until combined. 2. Shape into 8–10 small balls. 3. Roll in ground seeds for a gentle coating. 💡 Texture & Nutrition: Ultra-soft, keeps up to 5 days in the fridge. Rich in fiber, healthy fats, and beta-carotene → perfect for stable energy and gentle digestion.   #toddlerrecipes #realsnacks #healthysnackideas #blwrecipes
